definitions.explanation: An affectionate and casual way to address or refer to one's older brother.

definitions.gloss: young man; big brother (to a stranger)
definitions.explanation: Used by children to address an unfamiliar young man in a friendly way.

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}ちゃん、⟦{遊|あそ}ぼう→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
お{兄|にい}ちゃん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My big brother is going to college now.

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}ちゃん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{心強|こころづよ}い→心強い：16315_kokorozuyoi⟧。
examples.english: Having a big brother is reassuring.

examples.japanese: お{兄|にい}ちゃん、⟦{風船|ふうせん}→風船：14623_fuusen⟧とって。
examples.english: Mister, get my balloon for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{兄|にい}ちゃん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: A child I didn't know called me 'big brother.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「お{兄|にい}ちゃん、⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: A little kid at the park said to me, 'Hey mister, let's play soccer together.'

notes:
The most casual and affectionate way to say "older brother." Primarily used by younger siblings, especially children. The お prefix and ちゃん suffix together create a warm, familiar tone.

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- お{兄|にい}ちゃん: casual, affectionate (children and close family)
- ⟦お{兄|にい}さん→お兄さん：02858_oniisan⟧: standard polite form
- ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧: humble form used when speaking about one's own brother to outsiders
- ⟦{兄貴|あにき}→兄貴：11623_aniki⟧: informal, used among young men; sometimes used toward non-family

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{兄|にい}ちゃんっ{子|こ}: a child who adores their older brother
- お{兄|にい}ちゃん⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧: I love my big brother

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{兄|にい}さん→お兄さん：02858_oniisan⟧: older brother (polite) — more formal than お{兄|にい}ちゃん
- ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧: older brother (humble) — used in formal speech about one's own brother
- ⟦お{姉|ねえ}ちゃん→お姉ちゃん：27278_oneechan⟧: older sister (affectionate) — the female counterpart
